usedFor: A row in an Airtable content calendar becomes a post in Eclincher.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Post” in Eclincher
bestTemplate.why: It publishes the row's text to chosen brand accounts, with an optional scheduled time.

watchOut: Editing a posted row could publish it again, so post only when a status field says ready.
